title: ROS 2 tf2 "Lookup would require extrapolation into the future", "into the past" and "target_frame does not exist": lookup_transform timing, measured
excerpt: Why lookup_transform at now() failed 1,800 of 1,800 times at 10, 50 and 100 Hz, what Time(), a timeout and wait_for_transform_async cost in milliseconds, why a timeout fails inside a single-threaded callback, and how cache_time causes the past error. Measured in rclpy on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
